headline: SSX: the run now starts on top of the mountain
lede: Heats open standing at the summit with the valley falling away below the gate, every mountain rides its own original big-beat track, and carving, wind, landings and crashes finally have voices.

notes.text: Summit-vista countdown: during the 3-2-1 the camera parks high and wide, looking down the whole face, then swoops into the chase-cam at GO.
Three original big-beat beds — SIGNAL HILL, NEON ASCENT, LONG SHADOW — one per mountain, and the tempo lifts with your speed.
Physical mix added: wind rising with speed, swish off hard carves, air hush on hangs, landing thud, crash rumble that ducks the music — all synthesized at runtime.
ssxcheck is up to 87 gates (7 new, mutation-proven); a full headless drive — vista, swoop, bed swap per heat, carve/ollie/boost/bail, iPhone tap start — passes 19/19 with zero page errors.
